scope: Only the two existing synthetic census children; not the full 17-child owner campaign, Mode-A, five routing tiles, learning, live task admission or cold complete-model qualification.

build.features: Cargo package defaults; do not add --all-features or pq-native-openssl
build.profile: Cargo release default; no RUSTFLAGS or profile overrides
build.scope: The documented build produces two examples. Only pon_work_expensive_v1 is executed in this component plan; shared-material and model generators are not executed. Build/setup have separate receipts and are not charged into the two 300-second native child deadlines.

seed.role: Predeclared historical mathematical stream replay under the newly built exact-C4 binary

child_execution_owner.original_args: run_bounded(argv, b'', timeout=300, stdout_limit=256*1024*1024, stderr_limit=1024*1024, cwd=C4_ROOT)
child_execution_owner.whole_ownership: deadline begins before Popen; bounded pipe read, wait and process-group cleanup; retain raw, stderr and terminal receipt even on failure

reader_and_binding_requirements: Apply the unchanged original standalone reader to each preserved full raw stream; require successful parser exit and report.status == complete.
Also require the observed native-record schema is v2 and observed_arms equals the exact 15-arm source array: the original reader intentionally accepts legacy v1/14-arm streams.
Bind report seed, target, attempts_per_arm=64, samples=8, reuse_attempts=16 and exactly the nine expected materials to the predeclared command; reader cannot infer the caller's requested counts.

Require the raw run_summary requested_cells=1080 and completed_cells+unsupported_cells+failed_cells=1080 per child, with failed_cells=0; retain legitimate unsupported constructor costs instead of calling all 1080 cells complete.
Require both Dense and Sparse complete in all 72 class/sample cells per child, each with 64 actual attempts and four setups. Never treat zero-attempt or unsupported arm as a fast result.

The reader checks same-task stream equality across arms, canonical fields, ticket hashing, all misses, both successful native/scalar verdicts on each hit, phase sums, setup epochs, actual lifetimes and cache teardown boundaries.
Independently compare material task/A/B identities and per-class/sample trace_sequence_sha256 across the two target reports. Source challenges omit target; work IDs include target.

Require authoritative child exit=0, no ProcessFailure/timeout/output overflow, exact-source before/after guards and locked-build/actual-executed-ELF binding separately. A valid self-reported JSONL stream is not native execution proof.
Preserve failed/truncated output and reader errors with their own raw hashes; do not silently retry, select a faster sample, lower defaults or promote partial cells.
timing_and_inference_limits: Producer timing sums disjoint actual setup, all 64 attempts including misses, proof cleanup and completed epoch teardown. Material construction and identity/rank preparation are separate.
Observed cell clocks, whole native run clocks and external child envelopes overlap producer/verification timings; do not add nested envelopes.
All hits run both full native and scalar verifier entry points, each separately timed; proof generation and record/hash/output overhead have explicit different scopes.
Keep original 2 calibration + 6 evaluation samples and original 1ms/5ms/20ms postprocessed prefix budgets; prefixes settle only actual destroyed cache epochs and are not executed early-stop trials.

Use per-class, per-target, same-sample Dense/Sparse comparisons and ratio of aggregate like-for-like costs. The original reader's arm selection uses calibration aggregate CPU and a fixed tie order, then evaluates later samples.

Eight samples do not balance fifteen arm positions. Dense is first and Sparse last in sample zero; Sparse immediately precedes Dense in samples one through seven. Keep this original schedule and disclose possible order/cache effects; do not claim randomized or balanced comparison.

Finite nine-class/fifteen-arm results can expose known cheaper legal strategies. They cannot prove a global attacker lower bound, ordinary task eligibility, public service liveness, WAN behavior, honest-failure budget or model utility.
Reuse is sixteen attempts per constructed task, not sixteen winners; these counts/recipes/challenge domains cannot be pooled with original legal-v3 H1/H8/H64 or reused-v3 H4.
Material creation internally includes all nine recipes; full-rank setup must not be billed as unavoidable cost for an attacker who only needs canonical zero/one-zero input.
This plan executes no material generator, NumPy baseline, learning trial, Mode-A or five-tile routing stage.
